templates.source: Official 3xLOGIC VISIX camera user manual 'VX-2A-B-IWD' (manualslib.com/manual/1148283/3xlogic-Vx-2a-B-Iwd.html?page=27, VIGIL Server Configuration — Network Camera Settings): 'For 3xLOGIC All-in-One cameras, the url will be automatically set to rtsp://[ip address]/ch0_unicasy_firststream' with stream type selectable as MPEG4 / JPEG / H264. The manual's literal 'ch0_unicasy_firststream' is a documented typo for the standard firmware path 'ch0_unicast_firststream' (ch0 = channel 0, unicast, firststream = main). Corroborated by the 3xLOGIC VISIX Gen III User Interface Manual RTSP Information/Authentication sections (manualslib.com/manual/1888140).

By-convention second/sub stream matching the officially documented main path 'ch0_unicast_firststream' (same ch0_unicast_<Nstream> firmware family). The 3xLOGIC VX-2A-B-IWD manual documents only the auto-set first stream literally; the VISIX Gen III UI manual confirms a configurable second/sub stream exists (RTSP 'Target Stream' selector) but does not print the literal sub-stream URL. Not published as verified.

unverified_leads.note: generic ch<N>_<N>.h264 lead (Hisilicon-style) — not the documented 3xLOGIC ch0_unicast_firststream form; cross-brand contamination, excluded.
generic /video.h264 lead — not confirmed in any official 3xLOGIC/VISIX doc; excluded.
generic /stream0 lead — not the documented VISIX path; cross-brand, excluded.
generic legacy MPEG4 lead — 3xLOGIC lets you select MPEG4 stream type but the resource path is ch0_unicast_firststream, not this; excluded.
Hikvision RTSP path — Hikvision cross-brand contamination; not a 3xLOGIC/VISIX documented path. Excluded.
Dahua-style path — Dahua cross-brand contamination; not confirmed for VISIX. Excluded.

notes: 3xLOGIC is a US professional surveillance brand (VISIX IP camera line, integrates with 3xLOGIC VIGIL Server/VMS). The only literal RTSP URL printed in an official 3xLOGIC document is the auto-set main-stream path in the VISIX VX-2A-B-IWD user manual: rtsp://[ip]/ch0_unicasy_firststream — a typo for the well-known generic 'ch0_unicast_firststream' first-stream path (port 554). Stream type is selectable (MPEG4/JPEG/H264). The sub/second stream follows the same ch0_unicast_secondstream convention but is NOT printed literally in an official doc, so it is left verified:false. VISIX cameras are also ONVIF Profile S compliant (VIGIL Server can auto-detect via ONVIF Device Manager), so the RTSP URI can alternatively be obtained via ONVIF GetStreamUri. All of the StrixCamDB leads (ch0_0.h264, video.h264, stream0, live/mpeg4, Hikvision /Streaming/Channels/1, Dahua /cam/realmonitor) are cross-brand contamination and none match the official 3xLOGIC path — excluded.
